en_verger.text: {greeting} St Macartin's. Macartin was a companion of St Patrick, so they say, and the first bishop in these parts. The building's from the 1840s, but there's been a church on this hill since long before.
Those old flags hanging up there are the colours of the Inniskilling regiments, laid up here when they came home. Some are so old they're more hole than flag. We don't dust them. We wouldn't dare.
